native_view_evidence.limits: Installed native mesh/skin untouched. Source-part shader changes display material only. Isolated/classified surfaces copy original native vertex attributes and skin with explicit shell/region index subsets; GPU skinning remains native. Magenta edges are an X-ray CPU-position overlay including hidden candidate triangles, not GPU displacement evidence. No terrain, seat, gameplay-scale, contact, desktop-input or FPS acceptance.

loop_time_rule: AnimationPlayer::_process_playback_data applies fposmod; the exact length maps to zero. Direct track queries retain the terminal key. Both paths are captured and separately enclosed.

effective_settings.source: pinned ResourceImporterScene INTERNAL_IMPORT_CATEGORY_ANIMATION_NODE defaults; no node overrides

platform_math.scope: Actual platform function replay; no assumed transcendental ULP bound or continuous time enclosure.

numerical_accounting.method: Outward binary32 endpoints include exact arithmetic and rounded/FMA results. Enumerate all binary32 dot intermediates, replay pinned-platform acosf/sinf/sin (including double scale0); enclose mixer/rest normalization, basis, affine FK, bind and four unnormalized influences.
numerical_accounting.limits: Per-operation checks at captured times, not an interval over time or a physical error budget. No fast-math reassociation assumed. No libm ULP allowance assumed. Platform mismatch rejects replay.

High side-wall island 14023/14024/14025 and the long wall facets are excluded. Plate-to-wall edges with no intervening bevel remain explicit boundary edges.

The complete perimeter stops where the faces turn into the tall longitudinal wall. Isolated side-wall candidates 6239 and 6241/6242/6243 stay excluded with the rest of the wall.

HindHoof.L.reason: The broad basal plate and its uneven peripheral lip form one disk. Returning rim faces 7574/7575/7706/7707 are included. The upper shell and long faces running from the perimeter toward the ankle are wall, including their downward-facing portions; no part of the full source shell is discarded.

HindHoof.R.reason: The broad plate and narrow rolled edge form one disk, including returning rim face 7712. The perimeter follows the existing plate-to-wall crease, retaining the small corner folds. Side-wall face 7754 and the higher downward-facing wall facets remain excluded.

anatomy_definition.definition: The material sole is the broad basal plate plus the rolled peripheral lip up to its existing crease into the longitudinal hoof wall. Every source-shell face is assigned explicitly. Bottom/rim are both included; wall and the open ankle boundary are retained as excluded provenance. Membership is not computed from a height, normal, weight, slip or connected-component threshold.
anatomy_definition.construction: Exploratory rest-space geometry located a provisional plate region. Exact face membership is the authored input; native original-material, classified and all-boundary comparisons from five directions supply the anatomical judgement. Neither an initial geometric screen nor connectivity validates anatomy; the unique Review must inspect the boundaries.

patch_definition: Explicit source-face partition into bottom plate, peripheral rim and wall; sole is bottom plus rim. Full shells and rejected negative-normal candidate retained. Exact inter-region edges and source-open edges enumerated. Independent material/anatomical acceptance remains required.
